terms_note: Not live-verified: built from the vendor documentation read on 2026-11-02, no call was made. Prices are credits per successful call at the documented $0.01 per credit (docs.stability.ai/pricing), and failed calls are not charged. Output ownership and permitted use are set by Stability AI's license terms, which were not read, so nothing is promised here. Check Paradox's and Steam's rules for AI-generated mod assets before publishing. A result flagged CONTENT_FILTERED is blurred by Stability and is refused here instead of being returned.

models.notes: POST /v2beta/stable-image/generate/core. 3 credits. Output is about 1.5 megapixels, chosen by aspect_ratio. No image input. Native transparency is not documented, so it is proven from pixels. Not live-verified.

POST /v2beta/stable-image/generate/ultra. 8 credits, about 1 megapixel. An edit sends the base image as image with strength 0.65 (an adapter default, not a vendor value: 0 returns the input, 1 ignores it), which re-renders the whole image and keeps no pixels exactly. No mask. Not live-verified.

POST /v2beta/stable-image/generate/sd3 with model=sd3.5-large. 6.5 credits, about 1 megapixel. Edits use mode=image-to-image with strength 0.65 (adapter default) and ignore aspect_ratio. Not live-verified.
sd3 endpoint with model=sd3.5-large-turbo. 4 credits. Same fields as sd3.5-large. Not live-verified.
sd3 endpoint with model=sd3.5-medium. 3.5 credits. SD 3.5 Flash (2.5 credits) is named in the docs but missing from the model enum, so it is not offered. Not live-verified.

POST /v2beta/stable-image/control/structure. 5 credits. The base image (an edit) or one geometry anchor (a generation) is sent as image and its structure guides the prompt. Output matches the input size, so the sizes shown are only the nominal request. The input must be 64 px or more per side, 4096 to 9437184 pixels, ratio between 1:2.5 and 2.5:1. This is the default for edits. Not live-verified.

POST /v2beta/stable-image/control/style (Style Guide). 5 credits. Needs exactly one style anchor reference, which is sent as image, with fidelity left at the documented default 0.5. It cannot edit. Not live-verified.
